hints.content: The hanger has equal weight on each side. Let's start by writing an expression for the weight on each side.

The left side of the hanger has $7$ weights, each of which weighs $\greenD{t}$ units.  

The left side of the hanger weighs $\greenD{t}+\greenD{t}+\greenD{t}+\greenD{t}+\greenD{t}+\greenD{t}+\greenD{t}$ units, which we can simplify to $7\greenD{t}$ units.

The right side of the hanger has one weight which weighs $49$ units.

So, the hanger shows us $7\greenD{t}=49$.

The weight labeled $\greenD{t}$ weighs $\dfrac{1}{7}$ as much as the $49$ unit weight.

$\greenD{t}=\dfrac{49}{7}={}?$
